conservation_status.note_en: The current species-level global category checked for this review is Endangered; local or legal categories may differ.
conservation_status.note_zh: 本次复核确认的当前物种级全球等级为濒危；地方或法律等级可能不同。

description.en: The largest land mammal in Asia, recognizable by its smaller, rounded ears and highly intelligent, social nature.
description.zh: 亚洲最大的陆栖哺乳动物，可通过其较小而圆润的耳朵以及高度聪明、具有社会性的本性来辨认。

anatomy.en: Asian elephants are smaller than their African cousins, reaching about 2.7 meters (9 ft) tall and weighing around 4000 kg (8800 lbs). They have a distinctive twin-domed head, small ears (often described as shaped like the map of India), and a trunk ending in a single, prehensile 'finger' at the tip. Unlike African elephants, only some male Asian elephants grow large external tusks; females and some males (called makhnas) have small tushes or no tusks at all.
anatomy.zh: 亚洲象比非洲象小，站立身高约2.7米（9英尺），重约4000公斤（8800磅）。它们有一个带有明显双丘状突起的头部、较小的耳朵（常被形容为形状像印度地图），象鼻的顶端仅有一个可抓握的「手指」。与非洲象不同，只有部分雄性亚洲象会长出巨大的外露象牙；雌性和一些雄象（被称为makhnas）只有小象牙或者根本没有象牙。

ecology_and_behavior.en: This review classifies the species as herbivore. Feeding, social behavior and activity can vary with age, season and locality, so details are tied to the cited species account rather than generalized from one observation.
ecology_and_behavior.zh: 本次复核把该物种归为草食性。取食、社会行为和活动会随年龄、季节与地点变化，因此细节应对应所引物种资料，不能从一次观察泛化。

habitat_and_distribution.en: Historically widespread across southern Asia, from Iran to China, their habitat is now severely fragmented. Small, isolated populations are now scattered across countries like India, Sri Lanka, Nepal, Thailand, and Indonesia (Sumatra and Borneo). They mostly inhabit tropical and subtropical moist broadleaf forests, relying heavily on proximity to water sources for drinking and bathing to cool down their thick skin.
habitat_and_distribution.zh: 曾经极其广泛地分布在从伊朗到南亚及中国的广阔区域，如今它们的栖息地已遭受到严重破碎化。小而孤立的种群现在零星分布在印度、斯里兰卡、尼泊尔、泰国和印度尼西亚（苏门答腊岛和婆罗洲）等国家。它们主要栖息在这片热带和亚热带湿润阔叶林中，极其依赖靠近水源的地方洗澡来为它们厚实的皮肤降温。

range_review.comparison_en: The previous center, zoom and every polygon coordinate are retained exactly. The polygon remains labelled approximate because reusable authoritative boundary geometry was not established in this review.
range_review.comparison_zh: 原有中心点、缩放级别和每个多边形坐标均完全保留。由于本次复核未取得可复用的权威边界几何，该多边形继续标为近似范围。

life_cycle_and_reproduction.en: Young develop in the mother, are nourished with milk after birth and require species-specific periods of care. Timing and litter size vary across populations and should not be generalized from captive records.
life_cycle_and_reproduction.zh: 幼崽在母体内发育，出生后由乳汁哺育，并经历该物种特有的照料期。繁殖时间和每胎数量因种群而异，不应把圈养记录直接泛化到野外。

ecological_role.zh: 作为森林生境中的草食性，该物种在食物网中传递能量；具体影响取决于当地数量、猎物或食物植物，以及所引生态来源描述的相互作用。

threats.en: The Endangered global category does not remove local risks from habitat change, direct mortality, disturbance, pollution or climate effects; the relevant combination differs across the range.
threats.zh: 濒危这一全球等级并不排除生境变化、直接死亡、干扰、污染或气候影响等地方风险；不同分布区的风险组合不同。

actions.en: Protect the habitats and ecological processes identified by range authorities, reduce documented direct mortality, and update management when population monitoring or taxonomy changes.
actions.zh: 应保护分布权威所确认的生境和生态过程，减少有记录的直接死亡，并在种群监测或分类变化时更新管理。

similar_species.en: Close relatives and regional look-alikes may share color or body shape. Confirm records with multiple visible characters, location and an exact taxon-linked source rather than a filename or single feature.
similar_species.zh: 近缘种和地区性相似种可能共享颜色或体形。记录应结合多个可见特征、地点和精确分类单元来源确认，不能只凭文件名或单一特征。

communication_and_senses.en: The species uses the sensory channels available to its class—vision, sound, chemical cues, touch or vibration—in combinations shaped by its habitat. The cited species account should be used before assigning a specific call or signal.
communication_and_senses.zh: 该物种会组合使用其类群具备的视觉、声音、化学信号、触觉或振动等感官通道，具体组合受生境塑造。指定某种叫声或信号前，应查阅所引物种资料。

seasonal_calendar.en: Breeding, movement, molt, dormancy or food use can shift with latitude, rainfall, temperature and resource pulses. A date from one population must not be presented as universal.
seasonal_calendar.zh: 繁殖、迁移、换羽、休眠或食物利用会随纬度、降雨、温度和资源脉冲变化。不能把某一种群的日期写成全球统一规律。

relationship_with_humans.en: Use, conflict, tourism and cultural relationships vary across the range. Safe observation avoids handling, feeding, playback, nest or den disturbance, and any approach that changes natural behavior.
relationship_with_humans.zh: 利用、冲突、旅游和文化关系因分布区而异。安全观察应避免触摸、投喂、播放叫声、干扰巢穴或洞穴，以及任何改变自然行为的接近。

evolution.en: Elephas maximus is placed in Elephas, family Elephantidae, order Proboscidea. This review follows the accepted species match cited in the taxonomy source.
evolution.zh: Elephas maximus归入亚洲象属、象科、长鼻目。本次复核遵循分类来源所引的接受种匹配。

field_signs.en: Tracks, calls, nests, feeding marks, molts or other indirect signs may narrow an identification but usually cannot confirm a species alone. Fresh sign near a dangerous or sensitive animal requires distance.
field_signs.zh: 足迹、叫声、巢、取食痕迹、蜕皮或其他间接线索可缩小鉴定范围，但通常不能单独确认物种。危险或敏感动物附近的新鲜痕迹意味着应保持距离。

text.en: Its accepted scientific name in this review is Elephas maximus.
text.zh: 本次复核采用的接受学名是Elephas maximus。

text.en: Endangered is the checked global IUCN category, not a regional legal status.
text.zh: 濒危是本次核对的全球IUCN等级，并非地区性法律等级。

text.en: The map retains the previous approximate range geometry and does not claim a newly verified boundary.
text.zh: 地图保留原有近似范围几何，并不声称这是新核实的边界。
